about_the_game:
COSMIC ASCENT is a calm and thoughtful 2D puzzle platformer set against the endless backdrop of space.

You play as a silent, determined heroine navigating a world built from starlight and stillness. No enemies. No combat. Just floating platforms, gravity-defying puzzles, and the quiet urge to climb higher.

Jump, think, and feel your way through each level as you ascend toward something greater—something beyond the stars.

Key Features

  • Emotional puzzle platforming in a cosmic setting

  • Transparent platforms and spatial puzzles that test precision and timing

  • A quiet journey led by a female protagonist

  • Minimalist visuals and a soft, ambient atmosphere

  • A calming soundtrack to guide your ascent

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux (Ubuntu 16.04 via Wine/Proton)
  • Processor: Dual-core 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD or similar)
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

Recommended:

  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: Embark on a quiet cosmic journey in this emotional 2D puzzle platformer. As a lone heroine, climb step by step among the stars. Explore silent platforms, solve puzzles that seem gentle but demand thought, and let the stillness guide you toward light, emptiness, and reflection.
